purpose: Universal Bin reference graph for humans, scripts, LLMs, generators, projects, and the Harness.

node.title: human-readable name
node.status: observed | specified-not-verified | generated | machine-verified | human-approved | failed | canonical
node.provenance: explicit | inferred | procedural | recovered | imported | verified
node.revisions: prior node snapshots when material fields change

edge.type: instance_of | generated_by | produced | derived_from | implements | verifies | failed_because | requires | supersedes | version_of | uses | where_used | answers | about

detail.kind: artifact | recipe | logic | evidence | failure | intent | etc
detail.title: display title
concepts: semantic concepts such as couch, furniture

retrieval: rank verification > direct relevance > user verdict > recency
return a compact reference packet containing concept + best implementations/recipes + rules + failures + evidence
learning_rule: An output can teach logic without proving intent. Keep logic verdict and intent verdict separate.
